prompt_en: An unmistakably adult 25-year-old Korean woman stands at a night crosswalk, photographed as a luxury fashion editorial. She pauses mid-stride after her phone lights with a message from someone she clearly knows; her razor-cool composure breaks for one heartbeat into a small, involuntary softened smile, and her hand tightens on a black fox phone charm. She wears a black blazer, short-hem dress, and opaque over-the-knee stockings, with a clean band of exposed upper thigh between the short hem and stocking tops. Her knees close together and her legs remain adducted. The actual upper inner-thigh contours bound a narrow triangular background opening, a thigh gap that reads as appealing focal geometry within the outfit. It is an anatomical opening, not a wide stance or garment seam. A polished head-to-mid-calf fashion campaign framing keeps the geometry legible at thumbnail scale and preserves a natural narrow space between her inner thighs. Her upright stance keeps her face and tailoring primary. Foxlike eyeliner, sleek black bob, and chrome jewelry create sharp black luxury against a beautiful toxic city edge. Acid-green and violet neon reflect from wet pavement; off-axis night flash sculpts her silhouette. Tasteful, fully clothed commercial fashion; realistic skin and crisp fabric.
